eps.ov: April 2025. While helping his childhood friend Naru Arata, Ao Fukai accidentally takes a bracelet being smuggled by Gazelle, Pippo, and Han Juno, and a Scub Coral suddenly appears, along with a G-Monster. Gazelle and his friends were smuggling the item to the Japanese Armed Forces, but they discover the bracelet is missing and go to find Ao to try to retrieve it. In the interrim, another Scub Coral and G-Monster appears, as Cristophe Blanc of Generation Bleu makes a deal with the Union of the Okinawa Islands government to take care of the new G-Monster. Ao soon realizes that the bracelet is one owned by his mother years ago, just as Gazelle goes to take it back.
eps.oa: أبريل 2025. بينما يساعد «أو فوكاي» صديقة طفولته «نارو أراتا» يأخذ دون قصد سواراً كان «غازيل» و«بيبو» و«هان جونو» يهربونه، فيظهر «سكَب كورال» فجأة ومعه «وحش G». وكان غازيل ورفيقاه يهربون الغرض إلى القوات اليابانية المسلحة، فيكتشفون اختفاء السوار ويذهبون للعثور على أو واستعادته. وفي الأثناء يظهر سكَب كورال آخر ووحش G آخر، بينما يعقد «كريستوف بلان» من «جينيريشن بلو» صفقة مع حكومة «اتحاد جزر أوكيناوا» للتعامل مع الوحش الجديد. ويدرك أو سريعاً أن السوار كان لأمه قبل سنوات، في اللحظة التي يذهب فيها غازيل لاستعادته.

eps.t: Call It What You Want (AO's Cavern)
eps.ov: The G-Monster continues its attack on Iwato Jima, and with Gazelle's help Ao pilots an IFO being transported by the Japanese Navy and uses it to defeat the G-Monster, his hair changing color to turquise in the battle, all while Team Pied Piper pilots watch, realizing that the IFO is the first ever model made.
eps.ta: Call It What You Want (كهف أو)
eps.oa: يواصل «وحش G» هجومه على «جزيرة إيواتو»، وبمساعدة «غازيل» يقود «أو» آلة «IFO» تنقلها البحرية اليابانية ويهزم بها الوحش، فيتحول لون شعره إلى الفيروزي في المعركة، بينما يراقب طيارو «فريق بايد بايبر» ويدركون أن هذه الآلة هي أول نموذج صُنع.

eps.ov: Ao is hunted down by the people of Iwato Jima because they still believe that he and his mother are to blame for the terrible accidents that befell the island when she appeared out of nowhere. While in the custody of local musician Kazuyuki Kinjo, Kinjo apologizes to him for what his generation has done, just as Ivica Tanovich of Generation Bleu seeks him out, realizing he is the pilot of the Nirvash. While Rebecka tries to convince the Okinawa Self Defense Forces to allow Team Pied Piper to get rid of the Scub Coral, another massive Secret appears to attack. Gazelle frees Ao who brings the boy back to the Nirvash, which he realizes must be the IFO piloted by his mother Eureka, and that he was the one meant to pilot it in her absence.
eps.oa: يطارد أهل «جزيرة إيواتو» «أو» لأنهم ما زالوا يظنون أنه وأمه سبب الحوادث الرهيبة التي حلت بالجزيرة حين ظهرت من العدم. وبينما هو في عهدة الموسيقي المحلي «كازويوكي كينجو»، يعتذر له كينجو عما فعله جيله، في الوقت الذي يبحث عنه فيه «إيفيتسا تانوفيتش» من «جينيريشن بلو» مدركاً أنه طيار «نيرفاش». وبينما تحاول «ريبيكا» إقناع قوات الدفاع الذاتي في أوكيناوا بالسماح لفريق «بايد بايبر» بالتخلص من «سكَب كورال»، يظهر «سيكريت» هائل آخر ليهاجم. فيحرر «غازيل» أو، فيعيده إلى نيرفاش، فيدرك أو أنها الآلة التي كانت أمه «يوريكا» تقودها، وأنه هو من قُدّر له أن يقودها في غيابها.

eps.ov: With renewed resolve to protect Iwato Jima, Ao takes on the G-Monster with some help. And in the aftermath, Ao begins to learn that the world is more complex than he realized. In hopes of finding his mother and learn more about his birth, Ao decides to join Generation Bleu.
eps.oa: يواجه «أو»، بعزم متجدد على حماية «جزيرة إيواتو»، «الوحش G» بشيء من العون. وفي أعقاب ذلك يبدأ يدرك أن العالم أعقد مما ظن. وأملاً في العثور على أمه ومعرفة المزيد عن مولده، يقرر أو الانضمام إلى «جينيريشن بلو».

eps.ov: While adjusting to life on Generation Bleu, Ao begins to feel uncertain about why he joined them in the first place. Meanwhile, Team Goldilocks is under attack during an operation.
eps.oa: بينما يتأقلم «أو» مع الحياة في «جينيريشن بلو»، يبدأ يشك في سبب انضمامه إليها أصلاً. وفي الأثناء يتعرض «فريق غولديلوكس» لهجوم في أثناء عملية.

eps.ov: Team Pied Piper is dispatched to aid Team Goldilocks, but upon their arrival, they find that their leader sacrificed himself to save his companions. After retrieving the pilots and their IFO, they return to confront the enemy Secret leaving an exausted Ao behind. After awakening, Ao hears from Chloe, one of Goldilocks' pilots about their battle with the Secret and comes with a plan to defeat it. While Ao confronts the Secret, he is watched by an enigmatic figure who takes an interest to him.
eps.oa: يُرسل «فريق بايد بايبر» لنجدة «فريق غولديلوكس»، لكنه حين يصل يجد قائد غولديلوكس قد ضحى بنفسه لينقذ رفاقه. وبعد أن يستعيد الفريق الطيارين وآلتهم، يعود لمواجهة «سيكريت» المعادي تاركاً «أو» منهكاً. وحين يستيقظ أو يسمع من «كلوي»، إحدى طياري غولديلوكس، عن معركتهم مع السيكريت، فيضع خطة لهزيمته. وبينما يواجه أو السيكريت، يراقبه شخص غامض يهتم به.

eps.t: No One Is Innocent (Bye Bye Angel)
eps.ov: The stranger, who names himself "Truth" invades Generation Bleu's headquarters in search for the Nirvash. After having a confrontation with him, Ao is knocked unconscious and dreams about Truth approaching Naru and disappearing with her. After waking up, Ao is informed that Truth was indeed at Iwato Jima and took Naru away.
eps.ta: No One Is Innocent (وداعاً أيها الملاك)
eps.oa: يقتحم الغريب الذي يسمي نفسه «تروث» مقر «جينيريشن بلو» بحثاً عن «نيرفاش». وبعد مواجهة معه يفقد «أو» وعيه، فيحلم بتروث يقترب من «نارو» ويختفي معها. وحين يستيقظ يُبلَّغ بأن تروث كان فعلاً في «جزيرة إيواتو» وأخذ نارو معه.

eps.t: One Nation Under a Groove (Blue Thunder)
eps.ov: A Secret appears in the Republic of Faisal Arabia, but on behalf of its interests, the United States government exerts its pressure on Generation Bleu to not engage it. Ao's comrade Fleur Blanc reveals to him the reason why she hates her father, Generation Bleu's president Christophe Blanc. Ao manages to cheer her up and both return with renewed spirits to battle when they are finally authorized to confront the enemy.
eps.ta: One Nation Under a Groove (الرعد الأزرق)
eps.oa: يظهر «سيكريت» في جمهورية «فيصل العربية»، لكن حكومة الولايات المتحدة، حرصاً على مصالحها، تضغط على «جينيريشن بلو» كي لا تشتبك معه. وتكشف «فلور بلان»، رفيقة «أو»، سبب كراهيتها لأبيها «كريستوف بلان»، رئيس جينيريشن بلو. فينجح أو في رفع معنوياتها، فيعودان إلى المعركة بروح متجددة حين يُؤذن لهما أخيراً بمواجهة العدو.

eps.t: In The Dark We Live (Enemy Below)
eps.ov: The Japanese government runs an experiment on Tokyo Bay trying to create its own Plant Coral. However, a Secret appears and starts wreaking havoc. Team Pied Piper is dispatched to the area, but when Ao is informed that protecting the city from the Secret is not their top priority, he leaves against orders to engage it.
eps.ta: In The Dark We Live (العدو في الأسفل)
eps.oa: تجري الحكومة اليابانية تجربة في خليج طوكيو محاولة صنع «مرجان نباتي» خاص بها. لكن «سيكريت» يظهر ويبدأ يعيث خراباً. فيُرسل «فريق بايد بايبر» إلى المنطقة، وحين يُبلَّغ «أو» بأن حماية المدينة من السيكريت ليست أولويتهم القصوى، يخرج مخالفاً الأوامر ليشتبك معه.

eps.t: Release Yourself (The Pied Piper of Hamelin)
eps.ov: A Scub Burst appears in Phoenix, Arizona and while Team Pied Piper is on standby waiting for an official authorization to intervene, Ao and Ivica get ahead to evaluate the situation. As they arrive there, Ao meets Truth once more, holding a group of survivors hostage while the US Army comes with a different approach to confront the enemy secret with disastrous consequences.
eps.oa: يظهر «انفجار سكَب» في فينيكس بولاية أريزونا، وبينما ينتظر «فريق بايد بايبر» إذناً رسمياً بالتدخل، يسبق «أو» و«إيفيتسا» الجميع لتقدير الموقف. وحين يصلان يلتقي أو «تروث» من جديد وهو يحتجز مجموعة من الناجين رهائن، بينما يأتي الجيش الأمريكي بنهج مختلف لمواجهة «السيكريت» تكون عواقبه كارثية.

eps.t: Plateau of Mirrors (Mirror of the World)
eps.ov: Team Pied Piper returns from a mission in Australia, unaware that they had brought with them a sand-like substance that makes the child pilots have strong hallucinations. Meanwhile Gazelle and his friends investigate the past of Ao's fellow pilot Elena Peoples just to discover that she is even more mysterious than they previously imagined.
eps.oa: يعود «فريق بايد بايبر» من مهمة في أستراليا دون أن يعلم أنه جلب معه مادة تشبه الرمل تصيب الطيارين الصغار بهلاوس قوية. وفي الأثناء يتحرى «غازيل» وأصدقاؤه ماضي «إيلينا بيبولز»، زميلة «أو» في القيادة، ليكتشفوا أنها أغمض مما تخيلوا.

eps.t: Step Into a World (Heaven and Earth)
eps.ov: Team Pied Piper goes to a Generation Blue Space Station to deposit the collected Quartz. While there a Secret attacks a Scub Coral that materialized in low orbit, and Pied Piper is sent out to intervene. Meanwhile, Truth begins to set his plan in motion, and Gazelle and his friends investigate the area beneath Generation Blue HQ, discovering the Coral Relic. When Ao manages to destroy the Scub Coral in orbit, it turns out to have the Gekko inside of it with the Nirvash Type0 piloted by Ao's mother Eureka.
eps.oa: يتوجه «فريق بايد بايبر» إلى محطة فضائية تابعة لـ«جينيريشن بلو» ليودع ما جمعه من «الكوارتز». وهناك يهاجم «سيكريت» «سكَب كورال» تجسد في مدار منخفض، فيُرسل بايد بايبر للتدخل. وفي الأثناء يبدأ «تروث» تنفيذ خطته، ويتحرى «غازيل» وأصدقاؤه المنطقة الواقعة تحت مقر جينيريشن بلو فيكتشفون «أثر المرجان». وحين ينجح «أو» في تدمير السكَب كورال في المدار، يتبين أن في داخله «الغيكو» ومعه «نيرفاش تايب زيرو» الذي تقوده أم أو، «يوريكا».

eps.ov: On board the Gekko, Ao discovers that the Eureka before him is a past incarnation of her, from the time she was still pregnant. Soon the ship is surrounded by the Japanese and Okinawan armed forces, all desperate to take possession of both the past Eureka and her Nirvash. While trying to figure out how to send Eureka back to her own time, Ao and the others are attacked by Truth.
eps.oa: على متن «الغيكو» يكتشف «أو» أن «يوريكا» التي أمامه هي نفسها في زمن مضى، حين كانت ما زالت حاملاً. وسرعان ما تحاصر السفينة القوات المسلحة اليابانية والأوكيناوية، يستميت كل منها في الاستيلاء على يوريكا الماضي و«النيرفاش» الخاص بها. وبينما يحاول أو والآخرون معرفة كيف يعيدونها إلى زمنها، يهاجمهم «تروث».

eps.ov: Despite Truth's intervention, Ao manages to return Eureka to her proper time, but hears from her that the baby she is carrying is not a boy, but a girl. After returning home to find more about it, he learns from his grandfather that Naru reappeared, but upon reuniting with her, the Japanese government declares claim of Iwato Jima and blames Ao for the death of one of its officers.
eps.oa: رغم تدخل «تروث» ينجح «أو» في إعادة «يوريكا» إلى زمنها، ويسمع منها أن الجنين الذي تحمله ليس صبياً بل بنتاً. ويعود إلى البيت ليعرف المزيد، فيعلم من جده أن «نارو» ظهرت من جديد، لكن حين يلتقيها تعلن الحكومة اليابانية مطالبتها بـ«جزيرة إيواتو» وتحمّل أو مسؤولية موت أحد ضباطها.

eps.ov: Wondering about Eureka's claim that the Secrets are not enemies, a sleep-deprived Ao is sortied along his team to confront a Secret which has appeared beside a Scub Coral that was mysteriously reactivated. Ao is shot down by the enemy and after waking up, he learns that the other Scub Corals arround the world are being reactivated, too, putting Generation Bleu in a state of maximum alert to confront the multiple Secrets emerging near them.
eps.oa: يتساءل «أو» عن قول «يوريكا» إن «السيكريت» ليسوا أعداء، ويخرج مع فريقه وهو محروم من النوم لمواجهة «سيكريت» ظهر بجوار «سكَب كورال» عاد إلى النشاط على نحو غامض. فيسقطه العدو، وحين يستفيق يعلم أن «سكَب كورال» أخرى حول العالم تعود إلى النشاط هي أيضاً، فتعلن «جينيريشن بلو» أقصى درجات التأهب لمواجهة السيكريت الكثيرين الذين يظهرون قربها.

eps.ov: Several countries join Generation Bleu's special operation to lure all Secrets that have appeared arround the world to a deserted area in the Arctic and destroy them. The plan goes well until Truth interferes and Ao takes the initiative to ensure that the operation ends with no civilian casualties.

Ao confirms that the members of Team Goldilocks are leaving ordinary lives as if they were never assembled at all. However, the public opinion starts turning against Generation Bleu and during an operation in the middle of the ocean, the Quartz Gun starts moving by itself. Truth snatches the gun from Ao who falls into the sea and has a brief encounter with Eureka who revels to him the reasons for her disappearance.

To protect his comrades, Ao surrenders himself, the Nirvash, and the Quartz Gun to the U.S. army. As the whole world questions about Generation Bleu's actions, Fleur and Elena decide to launch an attack on the carrier where Ao is being held to bring him back.

Furious upon hearing that he is actually a Secret who lost his memory, Truth destroys Generation Bleu's space station among thousands of satellites around the globe. The Allied Forces blame Generation Bleu for the incident and launch an attack against them. Truth takes the opportunity to infiltrate the base and attempts to steal the Quartz Gun, but is stopped by Cristophe who sacrifices himself to allow Ao and Fleur to escape.

After learning that both Elena and the members of Team Harlequin switched sides to join the Allied Forces, Ao and his friends manage to escape taking the Quartz Gun with them. With nowhere to run, the remaining members of Team Pied Piper are contacted by the Japanese government offering them shelter and support according to a deal Cristophe made with the Secrets before his death.

Team Pied Piper, the Japanese Government and the Secrets join forces to prevent the Allied Forces from claiming the Scub Corals' Quartz. While Naru rallies supporters for her cause of having the Plant Corals shut down. Elena joins the Allied IFO squad along Maggie Kwan, but Eureka appears before them and makes Elena remember the truth about her origins that she wants so much to deny. Soon after, both are dispatched to fight Ao, and when he manages to finally dissuade Elena, Truth appears before them.

Truth attacks Ao who is rescued by Naru when he teleports him and the Nirvash to her side at Okinawa. Reunited once more, Ao and Naru discuss the situation when Team Harlequin appears and reveals that Truth's current form is affecting all people infected by the Scub Corals and for being the son of a Coralian, Ao should stay away from him. Regardless, Ao decides to join his companions against Truth. Meanwhile, back at Eureka's timeline, her husband Renton boards the original Nirvash in an attempt to rescue her.

Truth and Ao fight for the Quartz Gun until it fires once more, erasing Truth and converting Ao's Nirvash into the "Nirvash Neo". It also rewrites history once more to render it like Generation Bleu defeated the Allied forces including Naru. As Naru is being hospitalized, Ao witness the Nirvash Spec V3 coming from the pillar and comes at its encounter, meeting his father Renton for the first time.

After having a brief encounter with the phased-out Eureka, Renton sets with Ao to Iwato-Jima where he thanks Toshio for taking care of his family and then decides to make use of the Quartz Gun to destroy the original Scub Coral at his timeline and prevent it from spreading itself throughout the dimensions. As Ao confronts him to stop it, he learns that surprisingly, Truth has not fully disappeared, but has become the Nirvash Neo's archtype instead. Ao then decides to make use of the Gun's last shot to change Eureka's fate and have her reunited with Renton. Because of it, Ao is transported to the year 2027 where he bids farewell to Truth and returns to Iwato-Jima to resume with his life, despite the fact that there's a chance that no one in the world remembers about him anymore.
